The dinosaur is grey with lighter underbelly and horn tips, featuring three prominent horns and a large bony frill. A small portion of a white vehicle is visible in the far left background.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly displays two large brow horns and one smaller nasal horn, matching the anatomical description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is open, revealing a distinct beak structure consistent with ceratopsian anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The frill is massive and extends well beyond the width of the head, dominating the upper rear profile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Forelimbs are shorter than hindlimbs creating a sloping backline.

The visible portion of the tail is thick and tapers quickly, consistent with the 'short and stout' description.
